text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Autumn—the day of the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for taking the trouble to come 
and encourage me, Hayahide.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Following the Oaks, 
I shall deliver a run worthy of your 
support once more.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I harbor no worries on that front. 
Rather than to encourage you, my reason 
for coming here today 
was simply that I wanted to witness it 
from up close.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
To see you make good on your word once 
again.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Give it your all, Phalaeno. 
—I have high hopes for you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Brian is not here, but... heh. 
In her own way, it seems she is looking 
out for you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
She might even have come to watch, for all 
we know.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... If so, let us show her. 
Just what manner of running I am capable 
of now.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. 
It was a grueling summer, was it not?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...There were countless things I wanted to 
say about this summer. 
Apologies, gratitude, reflections... 
Yet, I swallowed every single one of them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Instead, I offered expectation. 
I handed her the complete trust I held in 
my heart.
choice_data_list: After overcoming that summer, you can win.
After overcoming that summer, you can win.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Indeed...
choice_data_list: I'll be waiting in the winner's circle.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Haha.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —That was precisely what I wished to hear.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Rest easy. Those grueling days you 
assigned to me— 
even while bearing the burden of your own 
pain...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I shall now go forth and prove 
that they were not in vain.
choice_data_list: Thank you. I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Prepare nothing more than a proper 
welcome for me.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: —With a smile, naturally.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(The Club's expectations. My comrades' 
expectations. 
The Trainer's expectations—I carry them 
all.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: (This weight... is pleasant.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, I see. 
I am in remarkably fine form today.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ――――There is no possible way I could lose.
